test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is 484 sq. cm. If height of the cylinder is 7 cm, then what is the volume of the cylinder (in cubic cm)? (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Curved surface area of a cylinder = 484 sq. cm.

Height of the cylinder = 7 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder = 2πrh

Volume of the Cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Curved Surface Area = 2πrh

484 = 2 × (22)/(7) × r × 7

→ 484 = 44r

→ r = (484)/(44)

→ r = 11 cm

Volume of the Cylinder = πr²h

Volume = (22)/(7) × 11² × 7

→ Volume = (22)/(7) × 121 × 7

→ Volume = 22 × 121

→ Volume = 2662 cubic cm

**The volume of the cylinder is 2662 cubic cm.**
